card.name: Space before a quantity in science news
card.fires_on: The space just before a number in science and climate news, after phrases like "as far as", "about", "more than" or "up to". It also fires on the first digit of a year or number.

modes.label: Space before a figure
modes.description: A blank token after a comparison or estimate word, right before a number.

modes.description: The first digit of a year or number inside a research finding.

modes.label: Linking word before a duration
modes.description: A word such as "for" that leads into a time span.
modes.example: which remains in the atmosphere<< for>> more than a century.

card.writes: It suppresses data and dataset words, which suggests it pushes the next word toward a number or measure rather than a data term.
card.plain: It marks the point in a science news story where a number or amount is about to be given.
